responsibility: Implements shared process-launching, signal-handling, and temporary-file cleanup utilities used by standalone GCC helper programs such as collect2 and lto-wrapper. It owns the common execution path built on pex, including optional @response-file creation, verbose/debug command echoing, subprocess status decoding, fatal diagnostics for failed tools or signals, and centralized cleanup dispatch through tool_cleanup, while exposing global driver-style flags such as debug, verbose, save_temps, and dumppfx that control this behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file of the collect-utils pair: it defines the shared helper-program runtime behavior such as signal handlers, pex-based process execution, @response-file creation/removal, wait-status decoding, and cleanup dispatch. Unlike gcc/collect-utils.h, it contains the executable logic rather than the interface and tool-supplied callback declarations.
